title: Electricians, Here’s How Google Ads Can Double Your Leads

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative anecdote about an electrician named Mike, using Google Ads resulted in a 40% increase in booked jobs (this is an anecdote from the vendor's blog, not a measured study).
